I cannot say this.

Not because it reeks of hypocrisy and overweening condescension, although it does.

Not because I hate war, although I do.

Not because I hate the military as an institution, because I do.

And not because I hate those who served in the military, because I do not.

I cannot say it in the same way I could never tell a rape victim or a cult member “thank you” for what they endured.

I’m neither thankful nor happy that they had to endure it.

Except for evil people, they never would have had to endure it.

I’m not talking about those evil enemies or terrorists or whatever dehumanization is in vogue. I’m talking about all warmongers, all war lovers, and everyone else who gets excited about mass murder.

“Service” in this context can only make sense — let alone be glorified — in a culture of the enslaved who are taught from birth that “sacrifice” is the ultimate proof of love.

Only psychotics think that.

comment.name: Millard J Melnyk
comment.body:
"Hateful" has essentially become a mindless, thought-terminating smear label, much the same as "conspiracy theorist" used to be.

Get it: IT'S GOOD TO HATE EVIL.

If someone chooses to deliberately act intending harm, they've done evil.

If someone habitually, chronically chooses to do evil, they're an evildoer.

If an evildoer refuses to stop their evildoing -- especially if evildoing characterizes them and they identify with it -- they are an evil person.

It's simple.

They make their own choices. I can't undo them or lie that they didn't make them. Those choices lead to consequences. I don't choose those, either.

I just choose to call them what they are -- and, of course, they hate me for it.

Only one thing will eradicate evil and prevent its reemergence: thorough, unmitigated, uncompromising and, if necessary, violent hatred of evil.

If that disturbs you, then you need to reconsider your relationship to evil. And you need to learn what love is.

I don’t mean this figuratively, or as colorful hyperbole. I mean that the top layers of our most important institutions are actually, literally populated by people who are insane, who have cultivated a complete mental descent through the looking glass.
Agreed. Not metaphor. Not hyperbole. Bona-fide mentally ill, inhuman, murderous, psychotic.
The only reason you deny it is so that you can feel better about yourself.
But you fucking know.

comment.body:
Parasites be parasites, no matter the species. Just like mosquitoes, they'll just keep trying again and again until you smap 'em.

 You can't reason with people who have no interest in reason. You can't persuade people who are trying to con you. You can't "fight" or "resist" bullshit without succumbing to the lie that it's real enough and powerful enough to fight and resist.

 You can't meet manipulators in good faith, because they don't come in good faith. You need to grow up, get over yourself, and expose them for what they are: human rejects. Inhumans. Evil, demented, debilitated liars.

 Stop making them out to be  all that. They're not.

 What we can do are three things:

 1. Stop idolizing them, either as saviors or as devils.

 2. Obliterate their credibility.

 3. Strangle their money flows. Stop feeding money into channels that support them and obliterate the credibility of those channels.

 And yes, you need to rethink your complicity and culpability in the form of paying taxes.

 https://lionessofjudah.substack.com/p/you-will-eat-ze-bugs-and-be-happy
